answers.question: Is it crazy to do one more 16-miler on Wednesday so I feel ready?
answers.answer: No, adding another 16‑mile on Wednesday would break the taper. Keep the mileage low, use a short easy with strides, and rest on Thursday and Saturday.

new.analysis: This is a race week, so the volume is lowered and only low‑intensity sessions are kept. The plan keeps the heart‑rate well below 150 bpm and avoids any hard work that could hurt recovery. Strides on Wednesday keep legs quick without adding fatigue. The rider asked if another 16‑mile would be okay; the answer explains that it would break the taper and suggests a short easy with strides instead. Flags watch fatigue, pacing, sleep, hydration, and mental readiness.
